# Feats #354 evidence fixtures

These fixtures retain the exact 100 ordered raw Feat records from pf1-content 11.4.0 (`02f4ab0d92e0d64f9eb2d127f42fd809cb23db7d`), reviewed by Sol (AI curator) for the owner on 2026-10-11. Supporting system records use v11.11 (`418761d2e16a6037c0156bb4a241f7cea5a2986d`). The [inventory](../../../scripts/catalog/legal/feats-354.json) and [report](../../../docs/catalog-import/feats-354.md) explain every held disposition and independent calculation gap.

- `pf1-content/` contains complete raw root YAML; `supporting-sources/` retains governing, partial, comparison-only and rejected-owner bodies without applying inherited grants.
- `comparison-sources/` contains literal PCGen files at `25523dbcf10e86c280fc0f447167ea43d67419d3`. Partial comparisons and publication declarations establish only their stated scope.
- `provenance.json` and `bibliography.json` pin ordered identities, bytes and literal publication declarations.
- `preview.json` retains complete-source normalized roots. Portable selected imports have limited prerequisite lookup inputs, so tests compare mechanics/description/source facts separately and explicitly use the complete-source prerequisite facts.
- `release.json` is an isolated public held-only release containing legal rows and zero definitions/resources. It is not a deployed release.
- `original-identities.json`, `protected-context.json`, `verification.json`, `local-binding-proof.json` and `historical-binding-proof.json` record raw preservation, recursive context coverage, complete fresh artifact comparisons and separate source/local binding scopes.
- `data.ts` uses structural parsers to read snapshots. `sheet.ts` adapts held data to isolated Character-scoped public saved-sheet tests; it does not grant catalog admission or invent repeatability facts.

No previous fixture or owning inventory is modified. Absence and owned null remain distinct in raw source metadata and transport proofs. Legal clearance remains blocked by the named content and notice-chain holds; calculation limitations are recorded separately.

Correction round 1 independently compares all 100 complete prerequisite clauses with the imported atoms, recording fifteen parser or qualification errors and nested unchecked facts without changing the parser. The supporting-body audit covers 209 source occurrences and distinguishes literal governing inheritance from qualification and comparison. The same-name Inquisitor Second Chance source is retained solely to diagnose the wrong prerequisite identity. All existing holds, protected-root outputs and historical preservation commitments remain intact.
